title: Accept helper enrollment and saved production configuration work
problem: A helper cannot currently enroll through one protected request, and Off erases the scope required by the Runs On switch.
desired_effect: Accept the exact two implementation Actions and insert them before Arcadia's current proof Action, without changing that pointer or activating production.

does: Validate the pinned repository, main branch, reviewed base lineage, exact Ask SHA-256, queue revision 180, and exact settlement fingerprint
Commit and track only this reviewed script and descriptor, including these two normally ignored generated files, refusing unrelated local or staged changes

Use canonical Agent Ask settlement to add exactly enroll-session-through-governed-host-request and persist-inactive-production-configuration with agent responsibility before prove-literal-split-browser-and-ledger
Retain bounded command logs and canonical receipts, and publish only the reviewed local main commits with a normal non-force push
never_does: Activate production, revive an old Grant, launch or adopt a worker, change provider permissions or spend policy, or answer another Decision
Change the current pointer, complete or amend existing Actions, merge, deploy, delete branches or worktrees, reset or rebase Git, or stage arbitrary changes

success.effect: Both implementation Actions are accepted and queued; the canonical settlement and this operator action are published on main. Production remains Off and the current proof pointer is unchanged.
success.next: The scheduled follow-up can inspect the accepted work and prepare the canonical execution handoff. Starting production and any changed On authority semantics remain separate explicit gates.

failure.effect: A stale or broadened precondition refuses. A script-only commit or applied settlement remains recoverable if a later command fails; nothing is discarded.
failure.next: Have the follow-up inspect the timestamped log and receipts. Retry this same action only for its unchanged operation or failed publication; moved queue, Ask or reviewed scope needs a fresh preview and refreshed action.
